summary:

If, like me, you loved the old Stuntman games on the PS2 and PS3, then the all-new entry Stuntman: Hollywood may be a dream come true.

This revisits the same old gameplay dynamic, where you need to drift and jump your car at the right moments in order to score points – but it actually incorporates real-life movies and TV shows into the mix.

Die for likes.
